name: swivel-windows
description: Convert, compress, rename, move and inspect files on your PC with Swivel's local tools.
long_description: Starts the Swivel installed on this PC with --mcp: the MSIX package's command, or the Swivel.exe from the portable ZIP chosen in this extension's settings. The extension contains only that launcher, which Claude Desktop's built-in Node.js runs. Turn on Agent Tools (MCP) in Swivel's settings first. Everything runs locally and only touches the absolute paths the assistant passes. Anything that writes is planned first and applied on request; new files go next to the originals and never overwrite anything, and every applied change can be undone (created files go to the Recycle Bin, renames and moves are put back). Swivel listens on no network port.

swivel_exe.title: Swivel.exe (portable ZIP only)
swivel_exe.description: Leave empty when Swivel is installed from the MSIX package. For the portable ZIP, choose Swivel.exe in its folder.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: List the conversions and tools Swivel offers for files, as action ids.

tools.name: inspect_files
tools.description: Check files and list the actions and tools available for each.

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Read the text of documents, and of images with on-device OCR (MSIX package).

tools.name: read_codes
tools.description: Read clean, flat QR code images.

tools.name: plan_action
tools.description: Plan a conversion or tool (e.g. convert.png, image.rotate, document.docx) and see what it would create.

tools.name: plan_compress
tools.description: Plan compressing images to JPEG or videos to MP4 under a file size.

tools.name: plan_rename
tools.description: Plan renaming files in place: base name, find and replace, prefix, suffix, numbering.

tools.name: plan_move
tools.description: Plan moving files into a folder on the same drive.

tools.name: apply_plan
tools.description: Carry out a plan once; records it in the undo log.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo an applied plan: created files go to the Recycle Bin, renames and moves go back.

tools.name: history
tools.description: List recently applied plans from the undo log.
